items.text: Giants RB Tyrone Tracy Jr. placed on IR with hamstring; minimum 4 games.
items.why: GM Schoen announcement via Schefter; suffered in Week 7.
items.implication: Cam Skattebo solidifies as primary; Singletary elevated; bye helps recovery.
items.opportunity: Skattebo workhorse snaps/carries/RZ with Tracy out.
items.conflict: Skattebo also dealt with hamstring concern post-game.

items.text: Lamar Jackson listed OUT in weekend fantasy injury summary.
items.why: ETR weekend report summary of reports.
items.implication: Huntley continues; Flowers/Henry still viable but lower ceiling without Lamar.

items.text: DeVonta Smith OUT alongside Dontayvion Wicks in ETR weekend summary.
items.why: ETR compiled weekend reports; missed practices.
items.implication: Eagles WR targets redistribute; slot/ Lemon type options elevated in MNF.
items.opportunity: Increased targets for remaining PHI pass-catchers.

items.text: Puka Nacua GTD with optimism; expected ACTIVE path.
items.why: ETR GTD/OPTIMISM designation from weekend reports; Schefter optimism on calf.
items.implication: Start with confidence if cleared; Adams/others secondary.

items.text: Breece Hall GTD with pessimism; unlikely to play.
items.why: ETR GTD/PESSIMISM; Rapoport sources say unlikely, not full participant after quad.
items.implication: Handcuff/backup elevated for Jets RB work.

items.text: Zay Flowers leads NFL in YPRR despite 64% targets from Huntley; Ravens 6th YPP with Huntley 50% snaps. Extremely excited for Lamar return unlock.
items.implication: Massive ceiling boost Week 8+ with healthy Lamar; start with excitement.
items.opportunity: YPRR elite; volume + efficiency with Lamar.

items.text: Ashton Jeanty epitome of high-value-touch RB thesis: worst runner (last in YPC 3.1, poor EPA/RYOE) yet RB13 PPR PPG via 9 inside-5 carries + league-leading 45 RB targets.
items.why: Data on goal-line and receiving despite inefficiency; backup better YPC in scheme.
items.implication: Sustainable fantasy RB2/flex via opportunity not efficiency; hold/start.
items.opportunity: High RZ carries + target share lead all RBs.

items.text: Jahmyr Gibbs almost certainly fine after ankle turn on purposeful slide; would have been tilting if injured avoiding TD.
items.why: Levitan assessment post-ETR watch list; Lions PPG dominance continues.

items.text: Dontayvion Wicks OUT with DeVonta Smith per ETR summary.
items.implication: Further concentrates PHI receiving with Smith also out.

items.why: ETR summary; later Schefter/Barkley comments hamstring/back came out great.
items.implication: Full or near-full workload expected post-clearance.

items.why: ETR IN list from weekend reports.
items.implication: Resumes Packers RB role; ROS value solid per analysts.

items.text: Bengals TE Erick All Jr. placed on IR with believed torn ACL; signed Cam Grandy.
items.why: Rapoport sources; watched by ETR Sunday.
items.implication: Bengals TE depth thinned; streaming options limited.

items.text: Bucky Irving not talked about enough as workhorse RB; emphasize his role.
items.why: Berry Pregame emphasis on usage as true workhorse.
items.opportunity: High snap/carry share as featured back.

items.text: Texans WR routes on 29 Stroud dropbacks: Nico Collins 24 (lead), Tank Dell only 6 in return, Noel 15 (left turf toe).
items.why: Post-game route counts; Dell limited return.
items.implication: Nico clear alpha; Dell not immediate threat to volume.
